caption: The image is a pencil drawing of a clear glass decanter with a round, textured stopper at the top. The decanter is depicted upright and centrally within a rectangular border on a plain, lightly yellowed background. The stopper has a diamond-like cut pattern, matching the lower portion of the decanter, which also features a similar repetitive, geometric, diamond-shaped surface texture. The upper neck of the bottle is smooth and narrows toward the opening, with a flat, circular rim just below the stopper. Around the midsection of the decanter, the word "BRANDY" is embossed in uppercase letters. The base of the bottle displays vertical ribbed designs. In the lower left corner of the border, the name "JOHN DANA" is written in small uppercase letters. There are some faint, irregular yellow-green stains and marks above the decanter and on the background. The overall color scheme consists of shades of gray from the pencil drawing, contrasted against the off-white paper.
title: Decanter
